scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:web

scripts.test:watch: tsx --test --watch src/app.test.ts src/app.integration.test.ts src/agent/tool-loop-agent.test.ts src/agent/purchase-agent.test.ts src/agent/llm-purchase-agent.test.ts src/domain/purchase-orders.test.ts src/llm/anthropic.test.ts src/tools/oc.test.ts
